newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P affirms Orix rating, removes from credit watch.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms Orix rating, removes from credit watch.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Thursday that it had affirmed its BBB long-term counterparty credit rating for Orix Corp and its affiliates and that the rating had been removed from credit watch.
The rating outlook is stable, S&P said in a statement.
The affiliates are Orix Ireland Finance Plc and Orix (Caribbean) NV, S&P said.

S&P said it believes Orix's acquisition of 289 billion yen operating assets from Crown Lease, a major Japanese leasing company that recently filed for bankruptcy, will not have a significant negative impact on the company's overall credit quality.
But it said it would continue to monitor the performance of the acquired assets.
